ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels vs 15% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at tips and scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous blobs located at the distal tips of both lobes, with more extensive mottling on the right tip. High-intensity linear and circular pixel clusters mapped to the left-medial and left-lateral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees; the apex is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right trailing edge exhibits high-frequency serrations with a pixel amplitude of 5-15 pixels. The left trailing edge is smoother with lower frequency variations. Both distal tips show extreme jagged, high-amplitude irregularity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a symmetrical convex mathematical curve from the central notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Three distinct high-contrast white crescent-shaped pixel clusters arranged in a horizontal row within the lower-left central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel vertical high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) on the left lobe, approximately mid-height, with additional unaligned diagonal streaks near the left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jagged truncation and tissue loss at the right-most distal tip, associated with high-intensity textured clusters suggesting barnacle attachment or heavy scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white 'mottling' pattern on the right outer lobe that transitions from solid white at the edge to discrete white specks toward the center.
